title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature adds the ability to parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, allowing for more flexibility in handling user input and improving overall framework usability. It will handle errors and edge cases, such as invalid JSON or exceeded payload limits. By adding this feature, yantraverse will be more competitive with other frameworks and better suited for real-world applications
testCases: Test error handling for invalid JSON
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when request bodies can be successfully parsed for both JSON and URL-encoded data, and error handling is implemented for invalid or malformed input
reason: Business justification: improves framework competitiveness and usability. Technical justification: enhances flexibility and robustness in handling user input
